metadata.regulation: California Fragrance and Flavor Ingredient Right to Know Act of 2020 (SB 312), Health & Safety Code 111792.6, on top of the California Safe Cosmetics Act
metadata.agency: California Department of Public Health, California Safe Cosmetics Program (CSCP); reported through the CSCP web portal
metadata.verification_note: NOT VERIFIED AGAINST THE OFFICIAL SOURCE. Entered from search-result summaries of CDPH's pages and law-firm alerts; cdph.ca.gov could not be reached from the build environment. Confirm every value against CDPH's SB 312 page, Compliance FAQ and fragrance allergens fact sheet before relying on a report.

allergens.comparison_note: CDPH says 'at or above'. EU labeling says 'exceeds', so a substance exactly at the threshold is reportable here but not labeled there.
allergens.list_note: CDPH's fragrance allergen list appears to track the EU's expanded list (Regulation (EU) 2023/1545, 82 substances). Unconfirmed.

other_fragrance_flavor_ingredients.list: CSCP Reportable Ingredients List (updated twice a year; 6 months to comply after each update). Not loaded: see cscp_reportable_ingredients.json.

deadlines.note: A CDPH FAQ was reported to tie allergen reporting to the EU timelines (2026 for new products, 2028 for existing). Unconfirmed; may already be due for new products.
